questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: The points $A(5,3), B(-2,0)$ and $C(1,1)$ are on a circle. Find the distance between the center of the circle and center of gravity of the triangle $A B C$.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{x}(\sqrt{1+x}-\sqrt{1-x})=?$

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: A body of mass $60 \mathrm{~kg}$ is suspended by two strings 6 and 8 metres long, their other ends being fastened to the extremities of a rod of length 10 metres. If the rod be so held that the body hangs immediately below its middle point, find the tensions in both the strings.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: A ship starts from a point with a velocity of $15 \mathrm{kmhr}^{-1}$ towards the north. At the beginning of its motion, another ship was observed at a distance of $10 \mathrm{~km}$ east of the first. If the second ship moves westward with a velocity of $20 \mathrm{kmhr}^{-1}$, how inuch time should lapse before they are at minimum distance? What will be the minimum distance between them?

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: For what value of $r$ will the coefficients of $(r+1)$ th and $(r+2)$ th terms be equal in the expansion of $\left(2 \mathrm{x}^{2}+\frac{3}{\mathrm{x}}\right)^{19} \text { ? }$

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text:
In a college, out of 80 students of class XI, 20 play football, 25 play cricket and 10 play both football and cricket. Out of them, one student is selected at random.
(i) If he plays cricket, what is the probability of his playing football?
(ii) If he plays football, what is the probability of his playing cricket?

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: Find the sum of the serics: $1+\frac{3}{4}+\frac{3.5}{4.8}+\frac{3.5 .7}{4.8 .12}+\cdots \infty$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The half-life of radioactive radon is 3.8 days. How long will it take for 30% of the original atomic number to decay?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A Carnot refrigerator takes heat from water at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and discards it to a room at a temperature of $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. If $100 \mathrm{~kg}$ of water at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ is to be changed to ice at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, what is the work required? [Latent heat of ice $=$ $3.4 \times 10^{5} \mathrm{~J} / \mathrm{kg}$ ]

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Each of two masses having $0.05 \mathrm{~kg}$ is attached of in and of same element suspended from firm support. he diameters of the wires are respectively $2 \mathrm{~mm}$ and $4 \mathrm{~mm}$ (young’s modulus = $2\ \times10^{11}Nm^{-2}$)

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A person aged 25 years gets into a spacecraft and returns after 30 years travelling at the velocity of $1.8 \times 10^{8} \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$. What is his current age ?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: An electron of mass $9.1 \times 10^{-31} \mathrm{~kg}$ revolves round a nucleus in a circular orbit of radius $0.53 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{~m}$. Find the centripetal acceleration and angular velocity of the motion of the electron.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A spherical oil drop, carrying a charge of $3 \times 10^{-10} \mathrm{C}$, has a potential of $500 \mathrm{~V}$ at its surface. If such two drops combine to form a single spherical drop, what will be the potential at the surface of this drop? $\left[\epsilon_{0}=\right.$ $8.85 \times 10^{-12} \mathrm{C}^{2} / \mathrm{N}-\mathrm{m}^{2}$ ]

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A bullet loses half its velocity after it penetrates 2 inches into a wall. How far will the bullet penetrate the wall?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Two equiconvex lenses, each of focal length $20 \mathrm{~cm}$, are placed in contact and the space between them is filled with water. Find the focal length of the combination.[Refractive index of glass $=\frac{3}{2}$, refractive index of water $=\frac{4}{3}$ ]

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: The volume of a gas in presence of a solid substance at $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ is $100 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$. When the temperature is increased to $54^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, the pressure of the gas with the solid is doubled and the volume becomes $100 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$, Find out the volume of the solid substance.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: Formation of $\mathrm{H}_{3} \mathrm{O}^{+}$ion is possible. Is formation of $\mathrm{H}_{4} \mathrm{O}^{++}$possible? Justify your answer.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: What happens when ethanol is treated with concentrated sulfuric acid at high temperature $\left(\approx 140^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ and at low temperature $\left(0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ ? Show the reactions. Mention how concentrated $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{SO}_{4}$ takes part at high temperature reaction.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: At $30^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ temperature and 1 atm pressure rate of dissociation of $\mathrm{A}_{2} \mathrm{~B}_{4}$ is $20 \%$; if pressure becomes double then which direction the reaction will be proceed explain mathematically.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: A mixed fruit juice was prepared by mixing $500 \mathrm{~mL}$ mango juice of hydrogen ion concentration $5.6 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{M}$ and $500 \mathrm{~mL}$ orange juice of hydrogen ion concentration $4.4 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{M}$. What will be the $\mathrm{pH}$ of the mixed fruit juice? Is the juice drinkable?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: Write down only the major reaction products of the following reactions.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: The production of sulfuric acid from sulfar involves three reactions. (a) Write down the reactions; (b) write down the type of each reaction; (c) identify the reaction that is carried out catalytically; and (d) name one such catalyst.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: Name the smallest member of amino acids. What are the common features of amino acids?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: The effect of temperature on reaction rate can be expressed by $K=A e^{-E_{a} / R T}$. Here $K$ is the rate constant and $\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}}$ is activation energy. The rate constant, K is $0.237 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and $2.64 \times$ $10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Calculate the activation energy.

questions.subject: english
questions.text:
Indicate, whether the following statements are true or false. If false, give the correct information.
(a) Exterior beauty is more admired than brain in the society.
(b) The range of our wisdom and experience widens with the progress of time.
(c) Physical beauty gives us transitory pleasure.
(d) With time and age physical beauty enhances.
(e) Brain helps us to perform virtuous activities.
